facts.fact: Hart 家画风：内陆德州的家却有海盐浮木味——像海边木屋；他开始练习「少把一切当作理所当然」。
facts.anchor: It even smells kind of like sea salt and driftwood.

facts.fact: 家史：两家祖辈都为 Grandaddy Smith 工作过；他的祖父母退休后搬去佛州海边公寓，社交生活比他想象的还精彩。
facts.anchor: My grandparents—family friends since before God himself was born, I’m pretty sure—all moved to Florida when they retired from ranch life

facts.fact: 家地图：Grandaddy Smith 赠父母一块三英亩多地；Harriet 和 Dean 在地另一头建小屋，与 Emmy、狗和 Dean 带他一起建的鸡舍同住。
facts.anchor: When Mom and Dad got married, Grandaddy Smith gifted them a parcel of land.

facts.fact: Dean 身份：犬科专科兽医；Flo/Dougie 是病弱新生幼犬被他每天数小时管饲救活——他本没打算养，最后舍不下；这也正是 Harriet 爱上他的部分原因。
facts.anchor: He’s a canine specialist vet, and these two were brought to him as sickly newborn puppies, right around the time he and Harriet met.

facts.fact: Dean 的事业：三月跑 Texas 10K 为自己几年前创办的狗救援组织 Tri-town Pups 募捐；三镇商户大多捐了款。
facts.anchor: He’s running the Texas 10K in March in aid of the Tri-town Pups, a dog rescue he set up a few years ago.

facts.fact: Brooks 的三十岁心态转变：想要父母有的、妹妹有的、Ev 和 Ruth 正在建的——肩上天使与恶魔结成同盟，劝他「是时候安定下来了」。
facts.anchor: I want what my parents have. What my sister has. What I see Everett building with Ruth.

facts.fact: Emmy 蜜蜂过敏：去年夏天被蛰脚踝才发现；幸运的是 Mama Tanner 抽屉里有 Ashton 上次回家留下的备用 EpiPen，医生说及时用上救了她的命。
facts.anchor: We found out the hard way about Emmy’s bee sting allergy last summer, when a bee got into the Tanners’ kitchen and stung her ankle.

facts.fact: Dean 的应对训练：教 Emmy 蜜蜂在身边时保持安静站立——不怕它也不挑衅它；他掏着 EpiPen 随时待命。
facts.anchor: We’ve been teaching her to stay nice and still when bees are around

facts.fact: Brooks 的决断：蜜蜂碰到 Emmy 背带裤时，他三步跨过门廊把她捞进怀里放上腿——「I got you, EJ」。
facts.anchor: I cross the porch in three steps and scoop her into my arms, returning to the sofa just as quickly and settling her in my lap. The bee continues to buzz

facts.fact: 怀抱气味：桃子酸奶+妹妹薰衣草香水——他在熟悉的味道里放松下来，Emmy 在他怀里睡着。
facts.anchor: She smells like peach yogurt and my sister’s lavender perfume, and I let myself relax into the familiar scent.

facts.fact: Bunny 危机：Hattie 哭腔来电——Emmy 丢了 Bunny 哭嚎；Brooks 挂断后发群聊 SOS（孕激素害的，他受不了妹妹哭）。
facts.anchor: SOS. Bunny down. EJ having meltdown. Meet @ moms asap for search party

facts.fact: 群聊反应：Ev 派活、Jody 意识流（先马后自行车）；Ashton 接连发来侦探式四连问——长相？最后出现位置？已知同伙？已知藏匿点？
Bunny 来历：Harriet 宣布怀孕次日他在 Farrow 买的——逛完整个店、装满购物车还是忘不掉那张对称可爱的小脸，折回去拿的；Emmy 出生后就离不开它。
facts.anchor: I bought Bunny for Emmy the day after Harriet and Dean broke the news that she was pregnant.

facts.fact: Brooks 的动摇：双辫+棒球帽的她骑马到场——明明只当妹妹看了二十年，这一眼却像第一次真正看见她，比 Bunny 失踪更让他心神不宁。
facts.anchor: But this feels like the first time I’m really seeing her, and something about that unsettles me even more than Bunny being missing.

facts.fact: 气质句：她能把麻袋穿成红毯礼服——天生如此；看她轻松发号施令，他胃里的不安更重了，连他自己都不知道该作何感想。
facts.anchor: She could make a goddamn sack look like some red carpet ballgown. She just has that way about her.
